about.summary: IT and Digital professional with 4+ years of experience across web development, IT operations, and content creation.
about.detail: Built a strong foundation in e-commerce at Daraz (Alibaba Group), contributing to platform UI/UX improvements and regional UAT coordination. Currently working in the financial services sector managing IT infrastructure, vendor relations, KYC operations, and day-to-day digital activities — equally comfortable handling a technical issue and a creative brief. Currently completing a BSc (Hons) in Computing at Wrexham University.
